items.title_en: US futures mixed as markets await data and watch Iran uncertainty
items.title_zh: 美国期指涨跌互现，市场等待数据并关注伊朗局势
items.summary_en: Associated Press reported mixed US futures before Thursday's open, with key economic data and uncertainty around Iran and the Strait of Hormuz still shaping risk appetite. The prior session left major indexes close to records rather than confirming a clean risk-on breakout.
items.summary_zh: 美联社报道，周四开盘前美国期指涨跌互现，关键经济数据以及伊朗与霍尔木兹海峡的不确定性仍在影响风险偏好。前一交易日主要指数仍接近纪录高位，但尚不足以确认单边风险偏好突破。

items.title_en: AMD reports fiscal Q2 as elevated expectations meet execution risk
items.title_zh: AMD 发布第二财季业绩，高预期开始直面执行风险
items.summary_en: AMD's investor-relations calendar confirms fiscal Q2 results were released Aug 4. The production quote proxy shows AMD closed Aug 5 at $482.05, down 7.04% from $518.58, so the briefing treats the reaction as a risk signal without inventing figures not present in the verified source set.
items.summary_zh: AMD 投资者关系日历确认公司于 8 月 4 日发布第二财季业绩。生产行情代理显示 AMD 8 月 5 日收于 482.05 美元，较 518.58 美元下跌 7.04%；因此本简报只把市场反应视为风险信号，不补写来源中未核实的财务数字。

items.title_en: AI earnings remain supportive, but valuation scrutiny is rising
items.title_zh: AI 盈利仍提供支撑，但估值审视正在升温
items.summary_en: Associated Press described US stocks holding near records after two strong sessions, while investors increasingly distinguish revenue and earnings delivered by AI spending from spending alone. That split argues for neutral regime labeling and a higher evidence bar for new paper-trade entries.
items.summary_zh: 美联社指出，美国股市在连续两个强势交易日后维持在纪录高位附近，同时投资者正越来越明确地区分“AI 投入本身”与“AI 投入真正带来的收入和利润”。这种分化支持将当前环境定为中性，并提高新模拟仓位的证据门槛。
